name: wayfinder-sidebar
description: A sidebar of your wayfinder map's tickets, or a plain plan's numbered tickets: ready, claimed and blocked, with buttons to open a ticket or start a session on it (optionally with a handoff from this session).

launcher.title: Where new sessions open
launcher.description: iterm opens a new iTerm tab, terminal a new Terminal.app window (both macOS only), copy puts the command on the clipboard. Other systems always copy.

editor.title: Editor for ticket files
editor.description: Command that opens a ticket .md file, for example code, cursor or zed. Empty uses the system opener (open on macOS, xdg-open on Linux).

pollSeconds.title: Local refresh (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to check local ticket files for changes made by other sessions.

githubSeconds.title: GitHub refresh (seconds)
githubSeconds.description: How often to re-read GitHub maps.

contextBudget.title: Context budget per session (tokens)
contextBudget.description: Where each session's context bar fills up and turns red. One ticket per session, under 200k tokens, is the wayfinder rule of thumb.

planPrompt.title: Prompt for plain plan tickets
planPrompt.description: What a new session is asked to do when you start a ticket from a plain plan (a .scratch folder of numbered tickets with no map.md). {ticket} is the ticket file and {plan} its folder, both relative to the project root. Must contain {ticket}.
planPrompt.default: Work on the ticket {ticket} from the plan in {plan}/. Read the other tickets in that folder for context, then do this one and tick its checklist as you go.

ignoreDirs.title: Folders to ignore
ignoreDirs.description: Comma-separated .scratch folder names never shown as maps or plans, for example ci-report, drafts.
